description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeysTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing media key management components in a media server environment. It includes mock object initialization, creation and destruction of media keys, and session management functions.

classes.name: MediaKeysTestBase
classes.description: A base class for media key management tests, providing setup, teardown, and utility functions for creating and destroying media keys and sessions.

methods.name: MediaKeysTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys for a specified key system, setting up necessary mocks and expectations.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeys
methods.description: Destroys the media keys, unregistering the client and cleaning up.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a media key session for a specified key system.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets up an expectation that a task will be enqueued on the main thread and executed immediately.
